settings.text: Brightens and hydrates the delicate eye area as it covers. Hides shadows, redness and spots with a flexible, crease-resistant finish that does not dry out.

settings.text: Stabilised vitamin C, peptides, hyaluronic acid and a plant-derived emollient. Made without silicones, fragrance or the ingredients on our banned list.

settings.label: Clinical results

settings.label: How to use

settings.label: Where does it go in my routine?
settings.text: After moisturizer and sunscreen, before powder. If you also use a corrector, apply that first.

settings.label: How long does it last?
settings.text: Most people get a full workday. Set with powder for extra staying power in heat.

settings.label: Is it right for dry or oily skin?
settings.text: Yes to both. The hydrating base suits dry skin, and the soft-focus pigments stay put on oilier skin.

settings.label: Can I use it on blemishes?
settings.text: Absolutely. Use a small brush for pinpoint cover and tap the edges to blend.

settings.label: Will it change color on my skin?
settings.text: A little oxidation is normal on some tones. Check your match in daylight and size down a shade if it deepens.

settings.label: Why is the cap color different?
settings.text: Each cap matches its shade family so you can find your tube fast in a crowded bag.
